meta.source: Nearest LSOA21 centroid assignment + IoD2025 mid-2022 population
meta.note: Approximate; not an official police LSOA count. Band = tertile within Cambridgeshire & Peterborough.
meta.percentile: pct is the share of Cambridgeshire & Peterborough LSOAs with a higher approximate recorded rate. Not a safety score. Rates use nearest-centroid assignment and resident population.
meta.trends: mv is a 12-month count of published crimes assigned to the nearest 2021 LSOA centroid, same method as the rate. Approximate, not an official police LSOA series.
